scope: API and numerical/resource limits for wave7, not a previous integration checkpoint
input_domains: strictly increasing finite endpoints/span and representably distinct axis nodes
sampled_positions: finite components within +/-1e12; degenerate triangle and zero/canceled global normal sums rejected
grouping: (uCell+vCell)%2; group1 nil only at1x1; all failures return two nil pointers
normal_uv_policy: Full-grid area weighted smooth normals before copying; global UV=(i/uSteps,1-j/vSteps); no periodic seam weld or analytic derivative sampling.
